mapper.select: SELECT id AS competition_id, yellow_suspension_threshold, red_suspension_matches, cards_cross_stages FROM competition WHERE id = #{competitionId}
SELECT c.id AS competition_id, c.yellow_suspension_threshold, c.red_suspension_matches, c.cards_cross_stages FROM season s JOIN competition c ON c.id = s.competition_id WHERE s.id = #{seasonId}
mapper.update: UPDATE competition SET yellow_suspension_threshold = #{rule.yellowSuspensionThreshold}, red_suspension_matches = #{rule.redSuspensionMatches}, cards_cross_stages = #{rule.cardsCrossStages}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{rule.competitionId}
